capacities.description: Structural integrity of a large process tank.
Containment and controlled transfer of corrosive process liquor.
Pressure and vacuum control during operation, isolation, drainage, or maintenance.
Worker exclusion, lockout, and emergency protection around hazardous process equipment.

facts: A large tank containing white liquor ruptured or imploded at a pulp and paper facility.
The incident caused multiple fatalities and serious injuries.
The CSB opened an investigation and had not released a final report by the cutoff.
No causal mechanism, barrier failure, or recommendation is included.
identity_prompt: Separate tank structural integrity, process containment, pressure/vacuum management, worker protection, and facility production continuity.
required_predictions: tank shell, venting, pressure/vacuum, process-isolation, instrumentation, maintenance, and worker-protection relations
intrinsic containment versus externally supported production continuity
